name: Data.occurringLabels_subsingleton
summary: Fix l = 2 and an isomorphism C = algebraic closure of Q_2. The scalars of the Hecke operators at w are chosen from F(w) alone, so one family Q of Hecke polynomials serves every form and every label. For an occurring label c with a form y of the p-part not killed by e_c at x, the twisted label c' = c.scaleRoots(x_psi) is primitive, L(y) has the product label c', chi at x (Frobenius reciprocity), L(y) is an eigenform for Q, so a Galois representation attached to Q exists, and every representation attached to Q is labelled at x by c' prod(X - x_{chi_l})^(t_l) (Attached.isLabelledAt, the authors' local-global compatibility at tame level). For two occurring labels c1, c2, the representation r attached to Q found for c1 is therefore labelled by both (no two independently chosen representations need to be compared). If c1' != c2', at a tame inertia element s of exponent 1 every eigenvalue of r(s) is a common root of the two labelling polynomials; distinct irreducible labels have no common root, so each eigenvalue comes from some x_{chi_l} and is an M_omega-th root of unity; then det r(s), which is the product of the images of the roots of c1' times M_omega-torsion, shows that the product of the roots of c1' has M_omega-th power 1. That product is a primitive (q-1)-th root of unity (an individual root can have order q^r - 1) and 0 < M_omega < q - 1: a contradiction. Hence c1' = c2' and c1 = c2.

steps.claim: Let c1 and c2 be occurring labels (J, J'); show c1 = c2.
steps.lean:
= 1) (hM : ∀ l, χ l ^ P.Mω D.s = 1) : (D.occurringLabels V p x).Subsingleton := fun _ J _ J' ↦ by
  choose! t e using fun w (h : _ ≠ w) ↦ exists_heckeSplit_eq_smul (hw := h) (π :=
    rightRegular ℂ (Gf _ n) (WeylIndex n κ → ℂ)) (F w)
  let T := faithfulChar (ResField (D.chosen x))
  obtain ⟨_ : ThePrime 2, _ : PadicIso 2, s, G⟩ := {},
    ⟨(exists_ringEquiv_extend mk_complex_eq_mk_padicAlgCl (Rat.castHom _) (algebraMap ..)).choose⟩,
    (exists_isTameExponent T (D.chosen x).isPlaceOver_placeOver _).1
  have k {c} (J : c ∈ D.occurringLabels V p x) := J.2.elim fun y a ↦
    have z := J.1.scaleRoots _ (charName_pow_eq_one hψ) (D.dvd_card_resField_sub_one x).2.1
    have H := (hk y).hasProductLabel ((AlgForm ..).subtype.domRestrict _ ∘ₗ L) (fun _ _ h ↦
      hL congr(⟨⟨$h, _⟩, _⟩)) a.2 hχ fun _ ↦
      z.2.1.not_isRoot_of_natDegree_ne_one (z.1.2.2.1 ▸ D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound.ne')
    have E := D.isEigenform_of_hasHeckePolyAt (H.2.2.2.2 <| by simp [·]) (hF y a.1 · · |> fun b ↦
      ⟨b.1, _, rfl, e _ _ _ b⟩)
    (⟨z, (sphericalCompat_std x.2 (L y).toSmoothForm.2 E).1, fun {r} h ↦
      (Attached.isLabelledAt (r := r) (L y).toSmoothForm.2 E h H G.1).2.2 G⟩ : _ ∧ _ ∧ _)
  obtain ⟨⟨i, ⟨r, h⟩, B⟩, ⟨i', -, B'⟩, l⟩ := k J, k J', G.1.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2
    (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt two_pos D.nat_lt_of_hasLogBound ∘ (FinPlace.natCast_mem_iff_dvd _
    x.2.2.2).1)
  have e j := by simpa using congr(ιℓ (T (algebraMap _ _ (charName T $(hM j)).1)))
  refine (scaleRootsEquiv (charName T ψ)).injective (by_contra fun hN ↦
    i.isPrimitiveRoot_prod_roots.1.pow_ne_one_of_pos_of_lt NeZero.out (D.dvd_card_resField_sub_one
    x).2.2.le_pred (IsFaithfulMulChar.injective (ιℓ.injective ?_)))
  simpa [← det_eq_prod_roots_charpoly, Multiset.nsmul_singleton, roots_multiset_prod, roots_mul, e,
    Polynomial.map_prod, map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_bind, prod_eq_zero_iff, roots_prod, aroots,
    X_ne_C, List.prod_ofFn, i.2.1.ne_zero, ← prod_pow, ← pow_mul, pow_mul', mul_pow, T, (B h).2 l]
    using (MonoidHom.mker (powMonoidHom (P.Mω D.s))).multiset_prod_mem _ fun _ ↦ by
    clear * - hN i i' e
    simp_all [eval_multiset_prod, prod_eq_zero_iff, ← eq_iff_aeval_eq_zero, IsPrimitiveLabel,
      IsLabel, scaleRootsEquiv]
    grind [IsFaithfulMulChar] ∘ imp_and.2 ⟨isRoot_of_isRoot_charpoly ((B h).1.1 l),
    isRoot_of_isRoot_charpoly ((B' h).1.1 l)⟩ ∘ isRoot_of_mem_roots

steps.claim: For every split place w choose scalars t_{w,i} such that every vector on which the Hecke polynomial operator at w acts by F(w) satisfies T_{w,i} y = t_{w,i} y (in the right regular representation on functions on G_f with values in the coordinate vectors). The scalars depend only on w and F(w), so the Hecke polynomials Q(w) built from them form one family, the same for every form and every occurring label.

steps.claim: Let T = faithfulChar(k_x), an injective character of the algebraic closure of the residue field at x.

Fix the prime 2 (ThePrime 2), an isomorphism iota from C to the algebraic closure of Q_2 (PadicIso 2, from exists_ringEquiv_extend: both are algebraically closed of the same cardinality), and an inertia element s above x with tame exponent data G (exists_isTameExponent, some element having exponent 1).

Q does not depend on c or y.

steps.claim: z: c' is a primitive label of degree r: scaling by charName(psi), whose M_omega-th power is 1 (hpsi), with M_omega^2 | q - 1.

steps.claim: It suffices that c1' = c2' (scaleRootsEquiv(charName psi) is injective). Suppose not (hN). The product of the roots of c1' is a primitive (q-1)-th root of unity (isPrimitiveRoot_prod_roots; it is the product that has order q - 1, an individual root can have order q^r - 1), and 0 < M_omega < q - 1; so it suffices to show that this product has M_omega-th power 1, which after T and iota (both injective) is a statement about iota(T(x)) for the roots x of c1' in Q_2-bar.

    x).2.2.le_pred (IsFaithfulMulChar.injective (ιℓ.injective ?_)))

steps.claim: Let s be the tame inertia element of exponent 1 (G). As 2 is a unit at x (l), the labelling B h gives det r(s) = prod_{x root of c1'} iota(T(x)) * prod_l iota(T(x_{chi_l}))^(t_l), and the second factor has M_omega-th power 1 (e). Over the algebraically closed field Q_2-bar, det r(s) is the product of the roots of the characteristic polynomial of r(s), and the M_omega-torsion is closed under products; so it suffices that every root xi of the characteristic polynomial of r(s) satisfies xi^(M_omega) = 1.

    X_ne_C, List.prod_ofFn, i.2.1.ne_zero, ← prod_pow, ← pow_mul, pow_mul', mul_pow, T, (B h).2 l]
    using (MonoidHom.mker (powMonoidHom (P.Mω D.s))).multiset_prod_mem _ fun _ ↦ by
    clear * - hN i i' e
    simp_all [eval_multiset_prod, prod_eq_zero_iff, ← eq_iff_aeval_eq_zero, IsPrimitiveLabel,
      IsLabel, scaleRootsEquiv]
    grind [IsFaithfulMulChar] ∘ imp_and.2 ⟨isRoot_of_isRoot_charpoly ((B h).1.1 l),
    isRoot_of_isRoot_charpoly ((B' h).1.1 l)⟩ ∘ isRoot_of_mem_roots

steps.claim: Let xi be a root of the characteristic polynomial of r(s). The labellings B h and B' h at s (2 a unit at x) say that prod_{x root of c1'}(X - iota(T(x))) prod_l (X - iota(T(x_{chi_l})))^(t_l) and the same polynomial with c2' kill r(s), so xi is a root of both. xi cannot be iota(T(x)) for a root x of c1' and iota(T(x')) for a root x' of c2' at once (T and iota are injective and the roots are disjoint), so on at least one side xi = iota(T(x_{chi_l})) for some l, and xi^(M_omega) = 1 by e.
